agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
April 13, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Councilmember Steve De Ruse
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ROLL CALL
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR DONATE LIFE MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim April 2021 as Donate Life Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to OneLegacy Ambassador Ryan Lo.
5.1 Proclamation for Donate Life Month
5.2
RECOGNITION OF MEALS ON WHEELS LA MIRADA – It is recommended the City Council recognize Meals on Wheels for its years of service and present a recognition plaque to Meals on Wheels President Debbie Garza.
5.2 Recognition of Meals on Wheels
5.3
91ST BIRTHDAY RECOGNITION – It is recommended the City Council present Rose Hamilton with a 91st birthday recognition certificate.
5.3 91st Birthday Recognition
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of March 23, 2021.
7.1 Minutes of 3-23-21 CC Mtg
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated April 13, 2021 in the total amount of $2,522,633.90.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-02, REPLACE THE EXISTING MARQUEE DISPLAY AT THE LA MIRADA THEATRE - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, AND AUTHORIZATION TO BID - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-02, Replace the Existing Marquee Display at the La Mirada Theatre; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.3 CIP No. 2021-02
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-03 CITY HALL CARPET REPLACEMENT - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, AND AUTHORIZATION TO BID - It is recommended the City Council approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-03, City Hall Carpet Replacement and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.4 CIP NO. 2021-03
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 21-10 WAIVING THE FORMAL BID PROCESS AND AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE OF TWO SERVERS, THREE MOBILE RADIOS, AND 14 PORTABLE RADIOS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-10 waiving the formal bid process and authorizing the purchase of two servers, three mobile radios, and 14 portable radios.
8.1 Resolution No. 21-10
8.2
APPROVAL OF THE EXCHANGE OF PROPERTY TAX REVENUES RESULTING FROM THE ANNEXATION OF TRACT NO. 82127 TO THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES LIGHTING MAINTENANCE DISTRICT 10045A - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-11 granting consent and jurisdiction to the County of Los Angeles in the matter of County Lighting Maintenance District 10045A and County Lighting District Landscaping and Lighting Act-1, La Mirada Zone A, Tract No. 82127; adopt Joint Resolution No. 21-12 on behalf of the City of La Mirada approving the exchange of property tax revenues resulting from annexation of Tract No. 82127 to County Lighting Maintenance District 10045A; and adopt Joint Resolution No. 21-13 on behalf of the City of La Mirada as successor of the Southeast Recreation and Park District approving the exchange of property tax revenues resulting from annexation of Tract No. 82127 to County Lighting Maintenance District 10045A.
8.2 Exchange of Property Tax Revenues
9.
NEW BUSINESS
9.1
CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION – It is recommended the City Clerk initiate the procedure for reorganization of the City Council.
9.1 City Council Reorganization
10.

CITY ATTORNEY ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
